# USDCkey.com

> USDCkey is a comparison site for USDC stablecoin debit cards. It helps users find the best crypto card for spending USDC based on their needs.

## Overview
- Compare 45+ USDC-compatible crypto debit cards
- Coverage across 30 countries
- 20 specialized use-case guides
- Data powered by Spendbase (spendbase.cards)

## Card Categories
- **Crypto-Native**: Exchange and wallet-based cards (Crypto.com, Coinbase, MetaMask)
- **On-Chain**: Self-custody, stablecoin-first cards (KAST, Ready, Phantom, Solflare)
- **Exchange**: Traditional crypto exchange cards (Binance, Bybit, Gemini)

## Key Features Compared
- Cashback rates and reward tokens
- FX fees and conversion spreads
- Custody type (Self-Custody vs Custodial)
- Supported blockchains
- Regional availability
- Annual/monthly fees

## Pages
- Homepage: https://usdckey.com/
- Card guides: https://usdckey.com/spend-usdc-with/[card-slug]/
- Use case guides: https://usdckey.com/best-usdc-card-for/[use-case]/
- Country guides: https://usdckey.com/usdc-in/[country]/
- API: https://usdckey.com/api/cards.json
